title: Arc
description: A character arc or subplot arc. Tracks the arc type, current phase, and the sequence of beats required for a complete arc. The Character Arc Ledger updates current_phase after each scene.

entity_id.description: ID of the entity this arc belongs to: a character_id or subplot_id.

entity_type.description: Whether this arc tracks a character, a subplot, or a character-pair relationship.

arc_type.description: Named arc template from the genre_profile or universal catalog (e.g. wound_and_healing, redemption, enemies_to_lovers, fall_from_grace, coming_of_age). Stub — expand arc taxonomy during Phase 7 implementation.

current_phase.description: Current arc phase. Mirrors character.arc_phase for character arcs.

beats_required.description: Ordered list of structural beats this arc must hit for a valid resolution. Stub — formalize beat taxonomy during Phase 7 implementation.

beat_label.description: Human-readable label for the required arc beat (e.g. 'wound revealed', 'false resolution', 'true change moment').

beat_id.description: Beat ID where this arc beat was delivered. Null until fulfilled.

target_scene_id.description: Planned scene where this beat should be delivered. Null if unscheduled.

status.description: Delivery status. Overdue if target_scene_id has been finalized without delivery.

resolution_scene_id.description: Scene ID where this arc reached 'resolved' phase. Null until resolved.
